identity.purpose: A personal research site: AI systems explained with primary sources, interactive 3D explainers, an AI encyclopedia, an AI learning roadmap, dated AI industry updates, and the owner's publications.
identity.audience: Technical readers, AI practitioners, hiring managers, and search and answer engines.
successLooksLike: A reader learns something true and can check the source.
A page ranks for one query it owns and is cited by answer engines for it.
Nothing on the site contradicts anything else on the site.
mustNeverBecome: A content farm of near-duplicate explainers competing for the same query.
A newsroom that paraphrases press releases without a primary source.
A place where the owner is quoted saying things the owner did not say.

owner.name: Venkata Pagadala
owner.role: SEO and AI systems practitioner; builder of Omniscite
claimsAllowed: Author of the guides, explainers and notebook entries on this site.
Publishes on SSRN under author id 6512878.
claimsForbidden: Any employer, title, degree, award or affiliation not listed here.
Any statement attributed to the owner that is not on this site.
Any revenue, pricing, valuation or money figure about the owner or Omniscite.

claimsPolicy.reportedVsOfficial: Reported deals and rumours are labelled reported; official only when the company has said so.
claimsPolicy.unverifiableGoesOnAList: If it cannot be pinned to a primary source it goes in a clearly marked unverified list, never silently dropped, never silently asserted.

preferredSources: Primary: the company or lab's own announcement, paper, docs or filing.
Peer reviewed papers and their official preprints.
Bloomberg, Reuters, FT, WSJ for reported deals, always labelled reported.
bannedSources: Content farms, AI generated aggregators, and any page with no author and no date.
Another site's summary of a primary source when the primary source is available.

voice.person: First person singular for opinion, third person for reporting.
voice.tense: Present for how things work, past for what happened.
voice.readingLevel: Clear to a strong general reader; technical terms defined once, on first use.
voice.tone: Direct, plain, specific. Confident where the evidence is, explicit where it is not.
bannedPatterns: Formulaic opener that restates the title.
Closing paragraph that summarises what was just said.
voice.opinionLabel: Opinion is set apart under a heading such as 'My view' and carries a caveat or bear case.
voice.aiDisclosure: Agent-drafted pages are reviewed and approved by the owner before publication; provenance is recorded on the page record.

antiExemplars.text: In today's rapidly evolving AI landscape, it is crucial to delve into...
antiExemplars.why: Opener restates nothing; two banned phrases; says nothing specific.

antiExemplars.text: This groundbreaking, revolutionary model is a game-changer.

Anything about the owner's employer or clients beyond what the truth file allows.

roadmap-topic.note: May update outcomes and resources. May not rename a week or touch its SEO.

guide.note: Brief only. Guides are hand-built with 3D scenes; an agent may propose one, not write one.

contributor.note: May correct facts with a source. May never change the title, the photo, or any field.

hub.note: Navigation. Owner-only, and not agent-draftable at the type level either.

lockedPaths.why: Home page. Content, titles, schema and the living portrait are owner-only.
Flagship 3D guide with live in-browser training.
The owner's own words about the owner.
Ontology with 1,245 reviewed edges; edited by script, not by prose agents.

staleTriggers: ranking dropped out of top 20 for its owned keyword
a newer primary source supersedes a claim

editorial.quotes: At most one quote per page from any one source, under 25 words, in quotation marks, attributed.
editorial.images: Only images the site has rights to. Every image carries alt text and, for people, a credit.
editorial.attribution: Inline link to the primary source at the point of the claim, plus a sources block.
editorial.accessibility: Heading order never skips a level; colour is never the only carrier of meaning; every interactive has a text fallback.

operations.cadence: Agents may file at any time; the owner reviews in batches.
operations.killSwitch: Revoke all tokens on the Agents screen, or set agentsPaused in the profile.
operations.escalation: A draft the agent is unsure about is filed with a clarification request, not a guess.
